Method of Attack: Spear-phishing emails delivering a RAR SFX self-extracting archive named winword.exe that installs a backdoor and shows a decoy document
Collects data from infected hosts and sends it to remote command-and-control servers
If infected host is valuable, delivers another malware family used in past DarkHotel attacks
Impacted Systems: Hosts infected via spear-phishing with political-themed malware
Indicators of Compromise: Decoy document listing email contacts for organizations in North Korea’s capital city
Command-and-control servers associated with past DarkHotel campaigns
